title: Workflow prompt fresh-task replication
hypothesis: The existing workflow-lite prompt lets Astra solve coding tasks faster while preserving verification, safety, planner and tool contracts.
falsified_if: The prompt transform fails activation or the screen loses correctness; weak or mixed latency evidence parks the candidate rather than proving a universal negative.
local_evidence: The preceding six-run screen passed with 14.2% lower coding latency and 4.1% lower coding cost, without fewer model calls. User authorizes a final take/drop decision and removal of the experimental switch. This replication uses investigation and stable regression tasks excluded from that prompt screen.

task_suffixes.simple_prompt: This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.
task_suffixes.ambiguous_bug_investigation: File scope: change only checkout/cache.py and checkout/service.py. Do not add files. This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.
task_suffixes.stable_verification_regression: File scope: change only billing/invoice.py. Do not add files. This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.

deterministic_outcomes: exact prompt transform and unchanged serialized tool schemas
decision_rule: Seed 924. Six launches: current and workflow-lite at Astra/high on simple control then two randomized adjacent coding pairs. Maximum $1.75 between-run standard-equivalent estimated cost (one-run overshoot possible), 360 active seconds. No retries; stop for correctness, protocol or activation failure. Drop the implementation if any run fails or the completed screen misses any gate: at least 10% lower aggregate coding latency, neither task more than 10% slower, coding cost at most 10% higher. A positive screen does not promote: proceed to fresh broader repeated validation, preregistered before collection. Final adoption requires all repeated runs correct, at least 10% lower aggregate coding latency, no task median more than 10% slower, and cost at most 10% higher. Otherwise drop. Preserve raw evidence and archive/remove the workflow-lite implementation and switch after either final decision. No grader/source edits during collection.
